title: A Combo of Poison and Medicine

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The three continue to climb the Tower of Luna, fighting the monsters that stand in their way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
立ちふさがる魔物との戦闘を繰り返しながら、
ルナの塔を引き続き登ってゆく３人。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Phew. We've defeated quite a few monsters, though it seems things are finally calming down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ。
ずいぶんと魔物を倒してきたけど、
ようやく落ち着いたね。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: I'm still good to go, but... certainly, it makes sense to rest while we're still able to. Are you okay with that, Mitsuki-san?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私はまだ平気だけど……
確かに
今のうちに
休んでおいた方がよさそうだね。
ミツキさんもそれでいいですか？

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: I'm actually a little tired, so I'd appreciate that idea.
text_block_list.orig_text: 私は少し疲れちゃったからその方が助かるわ。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Since then, she hasn't shown any kind of suspicious behaviour... That said, something still bothers me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれから不審な素振りは見せてないけど、
やっぱり何か引っかかるんだよな……

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: This may be none of my business since you've said that you're still good to go, Tomo-chan, but I'll make you some special herbal tea to help relieve your fatigue.
text_block_list.orig_text:
鍛えてるトモちゃんには
余計なお世話かもしれないけど、
疲れが取れる特製のハーブティーを淹れさせてもらうわね。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: That doesn't really concern me, so... I'll gladly take it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
余計なお世話だなんて。
ありがたくいただきますよ。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Hmm, maybe I'm overthinking things and trying to force her as evil in my head. I don't think a real bad person and {0}-san would get along.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
悪い方に考えすぎかな。
本当の悪人と{0}さんが仲良くするとも思えないし。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: I'll get it ready right away, so please wait a moment.
text_block_list.orig_text:
すぐに準備するから、
ちょっと待っててちょうだい。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Here you go, drink up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
どうぞ召し上がれ。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: That's quite an unusual smell.
text_block_list.orig_text: ずいぶんと変わった匂いですね。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: That's because it's a blend of many different herbs. But it doesn't taste bad, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
何種類も薬草をブレンドしてるからね。
でも味は悪くないわよ？

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Well then... I'll dig in. *gulp*
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ……
いただきます。
ごくっ。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: ...You're right. It has a refined taste that you wouldn't imagine from the smell.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ほんとだ、
匂いからは想像できない上品な味。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... so you drank it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ。
飲んじゃったわね。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: HUUUH?! D-Don't tell me it's poisoned?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ！？　
ま、
まさか毒を！？

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Indeed, it's a special tea made from a blend of many poisonous plants. Now, you should feel the strength gradually leave your body.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう、
それは毒草を何種類もブレンドした
特製のお茶。
さぁ、
どんどん体から力が抜けていくはずよ。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Khhh, I let my guard down. I knew it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっ、
油断した。
やっぱり……

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Just kidding, a simple joke. There's no poison in there. It'll help you relax, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なーんて、
冗談よ。
毒なんてないわ。
リラックス効果はあるけどね。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Wh-What are you trying to pull here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
どういうことですか？

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: I mean, Tomo-chan... you've been wary of me all this time, you know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって
トモちゃん、
さっきからずーっと
私のことを
警戒してるんですもの。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: If you're worried not only about the monsters but also about me, you won't last much longer in here, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物だけじゃなくて
私にまで気を張ってたら
この先持たないわよ？

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: ...So you've noticed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
気付いてたんですね。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Of course I have. My experience isn't just for show.
text_block_list.orig_text:
当然よ。
だてに経験を積んでないからね。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: For doubting you like that, I'm sorry.
text_block_list.orig_text: 疑うようなことをしてすみません。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: There's no need for you to apologize. That's part of your job, Tomo-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
謝ることじゃないわ。
それが
トモちゃんのお仕事だもの。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Besides, I wasn't lying when I said that it's a blend of several types of poisonous plants.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに、
毒草を何種類もブレンドしたっていうのは、
嘘じゃないし。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
text_block_list.orig_text: えっ！？

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: The poison has evaporated since it was fried at a high temperature. I wanted you to experience for yourself the uses of poison and medicine that I talked about outside the tower.
text_block_list.orig_text:
高温で炒ったから毒は飛んでるけどね。
塔の外で話した、
毒も薬も使いようっていうのを
身をもって体験してもらおうかな、
って。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Ah! Now you're giving me a look like you're not trusting me again. In that case, please lend me that tea for a second.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
また信用できないって顔してるわね。
それならそのお茶を貸してちょうだい。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: *Gulp, gulp, gulp*... Here, I hope you'll believe me a little now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごく、
ごく……
ほら、
これで少しは信じてもらえるかしら。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.orig_text: 私は……

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: It's fine. All I ask is that you trust me a little. Right now, we're partners in searching for clues to {0}'s memories.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいのよ、
少し信じてもらえるだけで。
今は
{0}君の記憶の手がかりを探す
仲間なんですもの。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
はい。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: On that topic, {0}-kun. You look pretty wistful.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ところで、
{0}君。
ずいぶんと物欲しそうな顔してるわね。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: That's right. It must be tough for you to be the only one left out, with just me and Tomo-chan getting to drink, so go ahead and have some. With this same cup... Oh my, does that embarass you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうよね。
私とトモちゃんだけ飲んで、
君だけ
仲間外れはつらいわよね、
さぁ、
お飲みなさい。
このコップでね……
あら、
照れているの？

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. I don't mind if you do, so go ahead and drink. Here, let me show where I put my mouth. Right here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふふっ。
私は気にしないから飲みなよ。
ほら、
私が口をつけたところは
ここだよ。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: As for me... right here. Now, from which side will you drink first?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は
ここね。
さぁ、
どっちから飲むのかしら。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Tomo, back to her usual self, and Mitsuki, who was acting the same as always, toyed with {0} as they proceeded to climb the tower.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつもの調子を取り戻したトモと、
いつも通りのミツキに翻弄されながら、
{0}は塔を登っていくのであった。
